summary.narrow: Easy west-of-Dili route linking a rare 17th-century Dutch fort, Portuguese-era ruins, basket weaving, beaches and seasonal whale/dolphin watching.

sections.content: Easy west-of-Dili route linking a rare 17th-century Dutch fort, Portuguese-era ruins, basket weaving, beaches and seasonal whale/dolphin watching.

entry.hours: The municipality/route has no single gate timetable; Maubara Fort, cafés, craft venues and marine trips operate individually.
entry.ticket: Public coastal road and exterior heritage views are free; fort/café, crafts and boat services may charge locally.
entry.closure_notes: Sea state affects marine trips; private/heritage interiors may have ad-hoc opening.
entry.status: open public-area circuit / verify individual stops
entry.notes: Official Tourism Timor-Leste places the circuit 30–60 km west of Dili on the coastal road, suitable as a half- or full-day trip.
entry.public_transport: Private car, taxi or tour is the most controllable option; local transport exists along the corridor but is less useful for multi-stop filming.
entry.last_mile: Fort/ruins and town stops are roadside or short walks; beaches and viewpoints require short local access roads.
entry.mobility_notes: Mostly low-friction road trip; ruins may have uneven coral-stone surfaces.

rules.permit_or_guide: No single route permit; ask locally before filming craftspeople/private interiors and use licensed/known marine operators for whale/dolphin outings.

safety.crime_context: Сопоставимой официальной статистики преступности именно по объекту нет; карточка фиксирует практические региональные, дорожные и природные риски вместо псевдоиндекса.
safety.confidence: site-specific crime rate unavailable; operational/natural risks sourced or explicitly marked as field-planning inference

seasonality.best_period: Dry season is easiest for road/ruin shooting; marine wildlife is seasonal and should be checked with current operators.
seasonality.heat_rain_notes: Hot north-coast conditions with strong sun; tropical rain can reduce visibility and road comfort.
seasonality.site_specific_notes: Whale/dolphin presence is seasonal and never guaranteed.

visual_recon.best_time: early morning or late afternoon on the coast; soft light for fort/ruins
visual_recon.drone: Coastal/heritage drone use requires aviation compliance and local/private-property consent.
visual_recon.filming_restrictions: Ask before filming weaving/craft production and private interiors; use distance-conscious practice for cetaceans.
